Eggshells are made from a mixture of calcium carbonate and other insoluble substances.
Calcium carbonate reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid. The equation for the reaction is shown.
CaCO3(s)  +  2HCl (aq)
CaCl 2(aq)  +  H2O(l)  +  CO2(g)
The other substances in eggshells do not react with dilute hydrochloric acid.
A student finds the percentage by mass of calcium carbonate in an eggshell.
